translation_notes: initBindings variable 'property' is not projected (only ?shape is), so it becomes a term interpolation {prop} in s{ }, per the bind_initbindings row of INSTRUCTIONS.md#2.
self.graph is not the module's current graph, so s{ } uses the explicit call suffix (self.graph) rather than reading an ambient @graph.

NodeShape and the label lookup it needs (itself an initBindings query one level up, in SemanticModelElement.__init__) are outside the extracted region; restored via a context shim (shim.py) faithful to shapiro_model.py's DESCRIPTION_QUERY/prune_iri, since the region's sort key (s.label) depends on them.

oracle: reading region (self.graph.query -> a value), not isomorphism; meta's initial oracle field was stale from the draft and the driver instead uses fixture.ttl via calls= (entry takes self, not a graph, so fixture= could not be used directly).
